detections.original: THERE ARE THREE MAIN CATEGORIES OF JOBS IN THIS WORLD. AT THE TOP ARE COMBAT PROFESSIONS, SUCH AS WARRIORS,MAGES,ARCHERS,ETC.

detections.original: NEXT ARE THE ENHANCEMENT PROFESSIONS, SUCH AS ENCHANTERS AND ALCHEMISTS. THEY CAN MAKE SPECIAL ITEMS WITH POWERFUL EFFECTS, BUT PURCHASING MATERIALS WILL INCUR ALOT OF EXPENSES, AND ONLY WEALTHY FAMILIES CAN AFFORD THEM.

detections.original: FINALLY, AT THE BOTTOM ARE THE LIFE PROFESSIONS, SUCH AS CHEFS, HERBALISTS, AND MINERS, ETC.THESE PROFESSIONS ARE ALSO THE FUTURE OF MOST PEOPLE, BE COMING ORDINARY PEOPLE, WORKING HARD, AND LIVING HARD..
